DI2.current_stage_objective: Run a bounded pilot that produces credible learning and prepares technical and business hypotheses for evidence-based testing.
DI2.next_stage_objective: Validate the technical and business hypotheses with representative evidence beyond an initial controlled pilot.

criteria.title: Bounded pilot executed
criteria.description: Evidence shows that a bounded pilot was executed against the scope it was intended to test.
criteria.user_action: complete and document the bounded pilot scope

criteria.title: Data access credible
criteria.description: The pilot has credible access to the data needed for the proposed test, with known limitations recorded.
criteria.user_action: confirm the required data access and document its limitations

criteria.title: Sponsor confirmed
criteria.description: An accountable sponsor is confirmed for the test and the decisions that follow from its evidence.
criteria.user_action: confirm the accountable sponsor for the test

criteria.title: Measurable success criteria defined
criteria.description: Measurable technical and business success criteria are defined for the next test without inventing unsupported thresholds.
criteria.user_action: define measurable technical and business success criteria

criteria.title: Pilot learning evidenced
criteria.description: The pilot produced evidence that identifies what was learned and why a broader test is justified.
criteria.user_action: document what the pilot demonstrated and why a broader test is justified

criteria.title: Risk acceptable for testing
criteria.description: The proposed test can proceed without an identified unacceptable safety, data, compliance, or operational risk.
criteria.user_action: complete the test-risk check and resolve any unacceptable conditions

criteria.title: Technical hypothesis validation
criteria.description: DI3 is expected to validate the technical hypothesis with representative evidence beyond the initial pilot.
criteria.user_action: validate the technical hypothesis with representative evidence

criteria.title: Business hypothesis validation
criteria.description: DI3 is expected to validate the business or operational value hypothesis with measurable evidence.
criteria.user_action: validate the business or operational value hypothesis with measurable evidence

criteria.title: Beyond-pilot validation
criteria.description: DI3 is expected to test whether the result holds in a representative context beyond the initial pilot conditions.
criteria.user_action: test whether the result holds beyond the initial pilot conditions

criteria.title: No feasible test design
criteria.description: Actual evidence shows there is no bounded and feasible test capable of validating the technical and business hypotheses.
criteria.user_action: define a bounded and feasible test design

criteria.title: Prohibited test condition
criteria.description: Actual evidence identifies a safety, data, compliance, or operational prohibition that prevents the proposed test.
criteria.user_action: resolve the condition preventing the proposed test

DI3.current_stage_objective: Validate the technical and business hypotheses with representative evidence and determine whether implementation is justified.
DI3.next_stage_objective: Establish production readiness, operating ownership, controls, and deployment evidence without treating implementation as automatic scale approval.

criteria.title: Technical hypothesis validated
criteria.description: Representative evidence supports the technical hypothesis and records material limitations or failure modes.
criteria.user_action: provide representative technical results and document material limitations

criteria.title: Business hypothesis validated
criteria.description: Measured evidence supports the business or operational value hypothesis at the level needed to justify implementation.
criteria.user_action: provide measured evidence for the business or operational value hypothesis

criteria.title: Success criteria evaluated
criteria.description: The test results are evaluated against the previously defined measurable success criteria.
criteria.user_action: evaluate the test results against the agreed success criteria

criteria.title: Representative context tested
criteria.description: Evidence shows whether the result holds beyond laboratory or narrowly controlled pilot conditions.
criteria.user_action: show whether the result holds in a representative context beyond the lab

criteria.title: Implementation owner identified
criteria.description: An accountable owner is identified for implementation and the operational decisions it creates.
criteria.user_action: confirm an accountable implementation owner

criteria.title: Implementation justified
criteria.description: The combined test evidence provides a credible reason to invest in implementation while preserving known uncertainty.
criteria.user_action: explain why the combined evidence justifies implementation

criteria.title: Production readiness established
criteria.description: DI4 is expected to establish the technical and organizational readiness required for production operation.
criteria.user_action: establish and evidence production readiness

criteria.title: Operating model established
criteria.description: DI4 is expected to establish how the solution will be operated, supported, monitored, and changed.
criteria.user_action: establish the operating, support, monitoring, and change model

criteria.title: Controls before production use
criteria.description: Applicable safety, cybersecurity, data-governance, compliance, and operational controls must be completed before production use.
criteria.user_action: complete the applicable controls before production use

criteria.title: Technical evidence does not justify implementation
criteria.description: Actual representative evidence shows that the technical hypothesis cannot support the proposed implementation.
criteria.user_action: address the technical evidence that does not support implementation

criteria.title: Business evidence does not justify implementation
criteria.description: Actual measured evidence shows that the business or operational hypothesis cannot support the proposed implementation.
criteria.user_action: address the business evidence that does not support implementation

criteria.title: Unacceptable implementation risk
criteria.description: Actual evidence identifies a safety, data, compliance, or operational risk that cannot be acceptably controlled during implementation.
criteria.user_action: resolve the unacceptable implementation risk

DI4.current_stage_objective: Establish production operation, controls, ownership, monitoring, and measured value evidence sufficient for a governed Scale decision.
DI4.next_stage_objective: Operate the deployed initiative at Scale while continuously monitoring health, controls, and realized value.

criteria.title: Production operation evidenced
criteria.description: Evidence shows that the implemented solution operates in its intended production context with known limitations recorded.
criteria.user_action: provide evidence of operation in the intended production context

criteria.title: Operational ownership active
criteria.description: Accountable operational and support ownership is active for the deployed initiative.
criteria.user_action: confirm active operational and support ownership

criteria.title: Production controls evidenced
criteria.description: Applicable safety, cybersecurity, data-governance, compliance, and operational controls are evidenced for production operation.
criteria.user_action: provide evidence for the applicable production controls

criteria.title: Monitoring active
criteria.description: Operational monitoring uses real telemetry and records relevant performance, drift, incident, and service health evidence.
criteria.user_action: activate and evidence operational monitoring from real telemetry

criteria.title: Measured value evidenced
criteria.description: Sourced measurements show the value realized by the deployed initiative rather than relying only on projections.
criteria.user_action: provide sourced measurements of realized value

criteria.title: Scale case credible
criteria.description: Evidence identifies where replication is appropriate, the constraints involved, and why wider use is justified.
criteria.user_action: document where replication is appropriate and why wider use is justified

criteria.title: Unacceptable operational risk
criteria.description: Actual evidence identifies an operational, safety, data, or compliance risk that prevents responsible scaling.
criteria.user_action: resolve the unacceptable risk preventing responsible scaling

criteria.title: Value is not being realized
criteria.description: Actual sourced evidence shows that the deployed initiative is not delivering the value needed to justify scaling.
criteria.user_action: address the evidence showing that expected value is not being realized

criteria.title: No feasible scale path
criteria.description: Actual evidence shows that the solution cannot be responsibly replicated beyond its current implementation.
criteria.user_action: define a feasible and responsible path for replication

DI5.stage_objective: Keep the scaled initiative deployed, monitored, controlled, and accountable for measured value while routing retire or rollback decisions to human authority.

criteria.title: Operational health monitored
criteria.description: Current sourced telemetry establishes the operational and service health of the scaled initiative.
criteria.user_action: provide current sourced operational-health telemetry

criteria.title: Realized value monitored
criteria.description: Current sourced measurements compare realized value with the recorded value expectation.
criteria.user_action: update the sourced realized-value measurements

criteria.title: Controls remain current
criteria.description: Applicable governance, compliance, safety, data, and operational controls remain current as the initiative evolves.
criteria.user_action: confirm that the applicable controls remain current

criteria.title: Operational ownership remains active
criteria.description: Accountable operational and support ownership remains active for the scaled initiative.
criteria.user_action: confirm the current operational and support owners

criteria.title: Drift and incidents managed
criteria.description: Drift, threshold breaches, incidents, upgrades, and decommissioning signals are recorded and governed from real evidence.
criteria.user_action: review and resolve outstanding drift or incident signals
